items.title: openclaw 2026.10.9
items.summary: 2026.10.9 Highlights Patch vulnerable runtime dependencies: fast-uri 4.2.3 rejects malformed URI schemes and hosts in MCP schema validation, oversized Zod collections are rejected early in A2UI and the Discord embedded app SDK, IMAP sender parsing uses nodemailer 10.1.4 so spoofed senders cannot pass the sender token gate, and Microsoft Teams uses patched MSAL Node 7.1.1. (#187294) Thanks @RomneyDa. Apply tools.fs.workspaceOnly to Gateway-built tools, so delegate changes still require approval and media tools stay inside the workspace. (#185094) Thanks @eleqtrizit, @RomneyDa, and @shakkernerd. Keep live credentials out of MCP CLI inspection and mask Google OAuth client secrets in logs. (#180321, #180308, #183193) Thanks @brandon-julio-t, @wr-web, @LeizhenZhang, and @RomneyDa. Make failed update rollbacks safe: Git-source rollbacks preserve operator edits instead of resetting the checkout, and npm rollbacks retry transient Windows denials and report the exact move that restores a bootable install instead of stranding the package root. (#185201, #184887, #185160, #184889) Thanks @wr-web, @syxscott, @LiuwqGit, @shakkernerd, and @RomneyDa. Recover intact agent databases and stale full-text indexes after SQLite tokenizer changes, including update snapshots. (#176234, #176220, #176833, #181206) Thanks @ndakota79 and @RomneyDa. Repair publication-complete updates after a remount while retaining the original launcher and sealed recovery helper. (#186557, #186527) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star, @sennyhoney, and @RomneyDa. Migrate large transcript archives without exceeding Node.js string limits. (#170853, #170847) Thanks @iamonlv426 and @RomneyDa. Allow agents to recover after a full disk once space becomes available, without requiring a restart. (#176902) Thanks @RomneyDa. Changes This maintenance release focuses on security dependency patches, recovery, data preservation, and reliability fixes. Fixes Resolve local media in Codex steering messages from the session's own workspace instead of the agent's default workspace. (#181528) Thanks @RomneyDa. Report uncertain process cleanup from buffered commands, such as local CLI speech providers, instead of presenting it as an ordinary command failure. (#184270, #184237) Thanks @shakkernerd and @RomneyDa. Keep reapproved node connections alive by publishing the approval with its committed pairing facts before the request resumes. Thanks @RomneyDa. Recover stopped Gateways when service activation cannot be verified; retain untouched-recovery behavior in Windows triage. (#172784, #181577, #181698) Thanks @SMF12138 and @RomneyDa. Avoid uninstalling a Gateway service during a passive macOS stop when no service is installed. (#181257) Thanks @shakkernerd, @LiuwqGit, @eleqtrizit, @syxscott, and @RomneyDa. Recover CLI Node runtimes when launched from the filesystem root, including launchd jobs. (#178112, #177739) Thanks @downingkeys and @RomneyDa. Start new ACP sessions in the requested working directory instead of the default workspace. (#176852, #123557) Thanks @yinx65588-boop, @crappier, and @RomneyDa. Prevent overlapping model refreshes from failing requests. (#179144) Thanks @RomneyDa. Honor an explicit SSH port 22 in openclaw gateway probe --ssh instead of the alias's configured port. (#171092) Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa. Keep skill metadata such as icons and homepages when an inline YAML metadata value has a trailing comment. (#171224) Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt, @Takhoffman, and @RomneyDa. Show provider-ignored options in openclaw infer video generate text and JSON output. (#171172) Thanks @ly85206559, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa. items.title: fix: streamed replies with a literal [[ in prose no longer re-parse t…
items.summary: fix: streamed replies with a literal [[ in prose no longer re-parse the whole answer (#187656) fix(reply): stop streamed replies with a literal "[[" from reparsing the whole reply When a streamed reply contained a literal "[[" that wasn't a directive, every new chunk made the stream reparse the whole accumulated reply looking for a directive, so long replies slowed down. The scan now keeps its Markdown ownership state between chunks and invalidates it correctly. That includes the case where a backtick-wrapped [[audio_as_voice]] is followed by another backtick. Real directives are still detected, and their metadata is published before text_end. Evidence: built Gateway with the real QA channel and loopback SSE. Canonical parse work fell by 95.5% in both serial 64 KiB raw turns, and the final text matched across all 16 fixture pairs. Four media controls and a Telegram Test Server guard passed, and directive metadata ordering is unchanged. Details are in the PR evidence comments. Thanks @JasonBuildAI. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: GitHub發表能在單一任務內跨模型協同的Copilot Fusion
items.summary: 微軟GitHub本周宣布Copilot Fusion協調系統已提供給開發人員，可讓Copilot自行依任務協調多個模型以完成工作。測試顯示比只用Claude Opus 5.5省一半成本。

items.title: PHP2Shell漏洞影響多家IT與OT廠商的產品，相關公告陸續出爐
items.summary: 由於PHP廣泛應用於各類IT系統，部分工業環境中的OT系統也可能採用PHP建置的網頁介面或管理平臺，因此，近期揭露與修補的PHP2Shell漏洞（CVE-2026-109618與CVE-2026-109619）不僅影響全球7成網站伺服器，同時對部分IT與OT產品供應商造成重大影響，許多人因此聯想到4年前爆發的Log4Shell漏洞風暴。

items.title: 微軟季度營收成長19%，Azure大增48%，Windows裝置下滑22%
items.summary: 微軟（Microsoft）周三（10/28）公布截至9月30日的2027財年第一季財報，該季營收達922.8億美元，年增19%，淨利（Net Income）366.3億美元，年增32%。微軟本季首度於季度財報中單獨揭露Azure營收，達331.7億美元，比去年同期成長48%。當天微軟盤後股價一度上揚3.48%，漲至549.44美元。

items.title: 中國駭客Volt Typhoon綁架連網設備打造攻擊框架Silent Train，用於攻擊美國關鍵基礎設施
items.summary: 中國駭客組織Volt Typhoon的活動3年前首度浮上檯面，當時這些駭客綁架多個廠商的網路設備建立殭屍網路KV Botnet，藉此隱匿地攻擊美國關鍵基礎設施。然而，在殭屍網路遭到執法單位圍剿後，這些駭客建置更為隱密、複雜，且動態的攻擊基礎設施，持續從事相關活動。

items.title: macOS 27.2未修補eMudhra憑證風險，Git與curl仍可能遭中間人攻擊
items.summary: Apple於10月26日推出macOS 27.2，但系統內建的Git、curl及Python 3等工具，仍可能接受印度憑證業者eMudhra已撤銷的問題憑證。研究人員10月28日公布測試，顯示攻擊者若能攔截或重新導向網路連線，可能冒充GitHub等網站，讓開發者下載遭竄改的程式碼。Apple已確認相關防護尚未完成，將透過後續macOS更新修正。

items.title: 美國制裁北韓遠端IT工作詐騙網絡，鎖定俄羅斯洗錢中間人
items.summary: 美國財政部外國資產管制辦公室（OFAC）於10月28日宣布制裁10名個人及1個實體，指控其協助北韓政府的遠端IT工作詐騙活動，包含在俄羅斯活動的北韓IT工作者、管理人員及俄羅斯籍洗錢中間人。
